searchText: Wrote a small note on FOCIL and Delayed execution potential incompatibilities: https://hackmd.io/@oK3in1lRQ7-pt7b3j8nQxg/BkZCQrPYyl/edit very correctly observed the issue with upfront payments from coinbase. I think as you noted we should just shift to an upfront deffered deductions from tx sender (on deferred start of block execution) and validity checks only ensuring that the tx sender has balance to cover all the tx fees of the sender I also wrote a small note on FOCIL with Epbs(EIP-7732) to compare with this trade offs: https://hackmd.io/@ttsao/focil-delayed-exec-under-epbs The pipelining benefits exists without additional changes, the only tradeoff is IL committee get lesser time

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: very correctly observed the issue with upfront payments from coinbase. I think as you noted we should just shift to an upfront deffered deductions from tx sender (on deferred start of block execution) and validity checks only ensuring that the tx sender has balance to cover all the tx fees of the sender

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
I also wrote a small note on FOCIL with Epbs(EIP-7732) to compare with this trade offs: https://hackmd.io/@ttsao/focil-delayed-exec-under-epbs
The pipelining benefits exists without additional changes, the only tradeoff is IL committee get lesser time
